From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Next steps & 30-min product walkthrough — proposed slots

Hi Liam and Harper —

Thanks again for a great discovery call earlier. To keep momentum, would love to schedule a 30-minute product walkthrough where Laura (our Solutions Engineer) can show a focused demo tailored to the use cases you described (offerings mapping, inference cost controls, and private deployment options).

Proposed 30-min windows (PT) — please pick one that works for your group or suggest alternatives:
- Option A: Tue, Sep 21 — 10:00–10:30 PT
- Option B: Wed, Sep 22 — 11:30–12:00 PT
- Option C: Thu, Sep 23 — 08:00–08:30 PT

Who from your side should join for the demo? My recommendation: product/ops, engineering (someone who owns integrations), and a security/compliance contact if available.

I attached a short agenda (Redwood_30min_Kickoff_Agenda.pdf) so you can see the flow. If you confirm a slot, I’ll send a calendar invite and a one-page pre-demo checklist to make the session as productive as possible.

Quick recap of next steps from my side:
- Confirm slot and attendees
- Laura to prepare a 15-minute hands-on demo + 10 minutes Q&A
- We’ll include a short overview of pricing bands and deployment options at the end

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

-Markus

Laura, would you mind tailoring the walkthrough to highlight: model routing across regions, how Dedicated capacity looks for a mid-market tenant, and an example of cost controls (batching + caching) applied to typical HR workloads?

For VerdantHR — to make the demo most useful, could you share a couple of quick items before the session (feel free to paste in the reply):
- Expected monthly inference volume (tokens / month or API calls)
- Main prompt categories (e.g., offer-letter generation, candidate summarization, benefits Q&A)
- Any hosting constraints (must be VPC-only, specific region requirements)

I’m also including a short pre-demo checklist as an attachment (pre-demo-checklist.txt). We’ll add a security contact from Redwood on the invite — our Security lead (Neha Kapoor) can join if you want a brief compliance Q&A.

All — confirmed for Wed, Sep 22 11:30–12:00 PT (calendar invite sent). We’re happy to have Procurement and Legal join; Laura will keep the demo focused and we’ll reserve the last 10 minutes for Procurement/Legal and a brief compliance Q&A with Neha.

High-level answers to Procurement’s asks:
- Attendee limit: demo sessions are informational — we typically include up to 8 people without any issue; if you need to scale the demo we'd be happy to provide a separate briefing for a larger audience.
- Pricing band (very rough, order-of-magnitude for planning): for companies your size and usage profile discussed on the call, clients typically land in the low-to-mid six-figure ARR band for a combined hosted + reserved capacity approach; smaller pilots can be done for under $25k ARR for a short proof-of-concept. We’ll provide a more precise estimate after we align on expected volume and deployment model.

Next steps from Redwood:
- I’ll send the calendar invite and a short pre-demo survey link (https://redwood-internal.sharepoint.com/pre-demo-form/VHR-2027) to collect the items listed earlier.
- Laura will prepare the demo deck and brief Neha on security points to be ready for the compliance Q&A
- We’ll create a HubSpot deal record (link below) and drop a one-pager on pricing before the call

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/VHR-2027-0922

Thanks — see you on Sep 22.
